sentences.text: Researchers developed a new compound to treat neuroinflammatory conditions by targeting the enzyme monoacylglycerol lipase. When given orally to male Wistar rats, this compound demonstrated strong enzyme-blocking power and maintained a half-life of 5.7 hours.
The substance successfully crossed into the brain and reduced inflammation in mouse models, matching its ability to block the enzyme in both mouse and human brain tissue samples.
The authors conclude that combining high-throughput screening with structure-based design and the Five-Star Matrix is an effective way to create drug candidates for neuroinflammation.
